Photo Editor Pro 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Comprehensive image editing skill combining AI-powered enhancements and professional workflows
- Features include AI auto-enhancement, background and object removal, color grading, selective adjustments, batch processing, and format conversion
- Supports common file types: PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP, and TIFF (read/write)
- Integrates with file systems, browsers, cloud storage, and social platforms for flexible workflows
- Flat pricing: $14.99 for lifetime access to all features and updates
